brief: Is meant to hold named objects and fetch one by name or position; it can not be built with a list today.
detail: Building it with a list raises R14, because init calls IsListOfNamedObjects on a stzList and that method does not exist, so Copy raises as well. A holder built without parentheses is empty; Content and Value return its empty list. NamedObject looks a name up and raises for an unknown one; its number branch tests the wrong variable and raises. stzNamedObjects is another name of it.
